items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: he told me about Raleigh Hamsley, the -- The catcher? -- the catcher, and several other guys.

ctx.x: So anyway, he takes out a couple of pamphlets out of his pocket, and he shows them to me. He says, 'Did you ever hear of the AAA?' I said, 'Yeah.' I said, 'I know about it.' 'Well,' he said -- 'Not much,' I said. He said, 'Well, I've been to a

meeting. I've been going to a couple, but, he says, I went to one, and he told me about a trumpet player. I forget what his name is, whether it's Wingy Manone or somebody like that. And he told me about Raleigh Hamsley, the --
